messages:
PagerBot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty alert fired for service `inference-hosting-prod` (INC12345). Trigger: error_rate > 5% across eu-west-1. Routed to schedule `legacy-infra-schedule`.
Maria (SRE): Wait what? inference-hosting-prod should route to `inference-oncall` not legacy.
Kevin (Oncall): I'm getting pages on phone for this — not me, i'm infra-oncall today. @PagerBot any context on the mapping?
PagerBot: Binding note: service `inference-hosting-prod` has an inherited binding to `legacy-infra-schedule` due to an historical PD integration created 2022-11.
Liz (Support): We're getting 3 customer tickets with errors in the last 5m, customers report timeouts. CX severity page already.
Dave (Eng): Can someone confirm if this is noise or real error? I see increased 5xx spikes on the metrics dashboard.
Maria (SRE): 5xx spike corresponds with multiple containers OOMing on r4 nodes. Likely config/regression from yesterday's deploy to inference-runtime.
Kevin (Oncall): I ACKed the PD incident to stop phone spam (ack by Kevin (Oncall)). But I'm not in the right rotation for this service.
Ops Oncall: FYI ack shows `ack by Kevin (Oncall)` in PagerDuty. Escalation policies are following `legacy-infra` chain now.
Maria (SRE): Can someone escalate to the correct oncall? Tagging @Ops Oncall to rebind service. Also estimating customer impact: 12 active requests failing, 4 customers hitting errors.
Ops Oncall: Attempting emergency rebind via PD: `pagerduty services update --id svc_abc --escalation-policy inference-policy` -> response: 409 conflict (service locked by legacy integration).
Dave (Eng): If PD rebind fails, we can create a temporary suppress on the legacy schedule to prevent pages and then manually notify inference-oncall.
Kevin (Oncall): Confirmed notification to inference-oncall Slack channel #eng-oncall and paging them now.
PagerBot: Automatic escalation to second level (legacy-infra-leads) triggered at +15m.
Maria (SRE): Do NOT let it escalate further. Creating temporary maintenance window on PagerDuty for `legacy-infra-schedule` (10m) to stop fanout while we triage.
Ops Oncall: Maintenance window created by Ops Oncall. PagerDuty comment: maintenance id mw-9876 starts now. Fanout paused.
Liz (Support): I posted a quick status update to affected customers and support queue: "We're investigating transient errors affecting inference requests in eu-west-1; engineers are actively triaging. Will update in 15 minutes."
Dave (Eng): Root cause hypothesis: yesterday's runtime change increased memory pressure at certain sequence lengths. Rolling back to previous canary on one shard to validate.
Kevin (Oncall): Who has permission to run rollback? I can trigger the rollback if SRE approves.
Maria (SRE): Go ahead Kevin, rollback shard eu-west-1-a to release 2025.03.1. Monitor for OOMs. Use the ops-runbook: ```./deploy rollback --shard eu-west-1-a --release 2025.03.1```
Kevin (Oncall): Running rollback now... logs: `initiated rollback job job_4523`
PagerBot: INCIDENT INC12345 status: acknowledged -> maintenance window applied -> manual escalation suppressed.
Maria (SRE): After rollback, 5xx rate dropped to baseline within 3 minutes on the rolled shard. Starting gradual rollout rollback to remaining shards.
Liz (Support): Customers notified of mitigation. No new support tickets in the last 10m.
Ops Oncall: After rollback completed across all shards, creating follow-up task to remove legacy binding: `PD service svc_abc remove-integration legacy-automation` and then rebind to `inference-oncall`.
Dave (Eng): Also add an automated CI test to catch the specific memory pattern that caused OOMs. Filing ticket: INF-987 memory-pattern-eval.
Maria (SRE): Thanks all. Postmortem owners: Maria (SRE) + Dave (Eng). Immediate actions: 1) Remove legacy PD binding, 2) add PD routing validation to onboarding docs, 3) ensure maintenance window permissions documented.
Kevin (Oncall): Quick note — ACK was by me but due to pd misrouting. Please annotate the incident timeline that ACK was from rerouted schedule.
Liz (Support): I'll schedule a customer follow-up email once postmortem is ready.
PagerBot: Incident INC12345 resolved (status: mitigated). Logs: mitigation via rollback + maintenance window.
Maria (SRE): Filing RCA draft and will ping owners. Closing thread for now — we'll open postmortem doc in #postmortems when ready. :white_check_mark:
